text:
maria.finance: @devin-cs heads-up — Asterium Labs (acct AST-993) invoice `INV-2829` is 48 days overdue, outstanding balance $48,750. Customer asked for a 3‑month split. They offered to pay $20,000 today + two instalments. Any objections to accepting partial capture and a formal payment plan?

 dunning-bot: Automated reminder sent to billing contact (billing@asterium.io) for `INV-2829` — 48 days overdue.

 devin-cs: They replied in the thread: can do $20k now, then $14,375 x2. CC on file expired. Asked if we can accept ACH or new card. Also asked to waive late fee — says cashflow crunch.

 maria.finance: Current late fee is $1,215 (per T&Cs). Finance preference: accept partial payment plan but require signed payment plan + ACH/CC authorization. We can consider reducing late fee if they sign within 48h. Need approval for reduced late fee and to accept smaller up-front.

 oliver-sales: +1 to keep them live, relationship matters. Approve the plan conditionally — but need PO or exec sign-off. Please send the plan doc and loop me in.

 kevin-fraud: Quick risk note: this acct had a spike in usage last month (+230%) and billing contact domain differs from purchase order. Recommend hold final access changes until first instalment clears. Also run a soft AML/KYC check on new payment method.

 maria.finance: Good catch @kevin-fraud — we'll require payment to clear before restoring any outstanding quota.

 jessica-cfo: Approve reducing late fee to $300 if they sign the plan by EOD Friday. Do not extend plan beyond 90 days. Confirmed we can accept partial capture of $20,000 once we have a valid instrument.

 devin-cs: I'll draft payment plan doc now and send to billing contact. Proposed terms in doc: 1) $20,000 due on execution, 2) $14,375 due 30 and 60 days after execution, 3) $300 flat late fee if missed, 4) access hold if first payment fails.

 maria.finance: Please include ACH authorization block + checkbox to allow automated drafting of remaining instalments. I'll prep a short SOA and invoice link: https://billing.redwood.example/invoices/INV-2829 (internal link).

 dunning-bot: Payment attempt failed at 2028-11-03 09:12 UTC for `INV-2829` — card expired.

 devin-cs: They say they'll provide new card by tomorrow morning. I'll ask for ACH as backup. @oliver-sales can you call the VP of ops if we don't get a new instrument in 36h?

 oliver-sales: Yep — I'll call now and follow up in thread. If nothing by Friday noon escalate to `collections-legal`.

 maria.finance: Noted — setting internal escalation timer 72h. If first payment hasn't posted by 2028-11-06 18:00 UTC, escalate to collections and pause service.

 kevin-fraud: Once payment method submitted, I'll run the risk checks and flag any issues. If we see mismatch again, recommend hold and require exec sign-off.

 devin-cs: Draft sent to billing@asterium.io, cc'ing @oliver-sales. Waiting for signed copy and payment.

 oliver-sales: Called VP — left voicemail, sent calendar invite. Will update in DM. :phone: :thumbsup:

 maria.finance: Thanks — will update ledger and schedule follow-up. If customer signs and first $20k clears, finance to mark invoice partially paid and close the escalation.

 jessica-cfo: Approved in thread. Keep me posted only if we need to escalate beyond collections (legal).

 devin-cs: will do.

 maria.finance: closing loop here — tracker updated, timer set.

 oliver-sales: handing off to collections if no payment.

 dunning-bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled for 2028-11-05 09:00 UTC.
